goals.title: Contract Gate
goals.objective: Create project scaffold and freeze shared lc-run/1, lc-replay/1, checkpoint, seed, observation/action, collision and lc-eval/1 contracts plus shared golden fixtures before implementation lanes diverge; test canonical digest and schema compatibility per approved PRD/test-spec.
goals.evidence: Frozen shared schemas/fixtures at schemas/ and shared/fixtures/; contract suite: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/contracts -v (11 passed); JSON parse (6 schemas, 7 fixtures) and compileall passed. No unresolved contract questions; no source engine/Kaggle job yet.

goals.title: Deterministic Engines
goals.objective: Implement seeded Python reference engine and vectorized runner, then TypeScript browser engine; prove collision rules, transitions, observations, seeds, actions and replay hashes match all shared fixtures exactly.
goals.evidence: Python and TypeScript deterministic engines implemented. Combined verification: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider tests/contracts tests/python_engine -q -> 19 passed; node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/typescript_engine/*.test.mjs -> 8 passed incl live Python differential; TS syntax checks passed. Shared collision/replay fixture contradictions corrected and replay digest matches regenerated records. No pycache remains. Static TS typecheck is unavailable (no TypeScript compiler configured); real T4/Kaggle run deferred.

goals.title: PPO Training and Evaluation
goals.objective: Implement two-agent PPO self-play with GPU updates when available, checkpoint resume/native save, ONNX export and fixed held-out lc-eval/1 reports/replays; produce a tiny CPU smoke and device/update evidence without claiming unmeasured learning gains.
goals.evidence: Implemented two-seat PPO with optional deterministic step-0 checkpoint opponent, global-target checkpoint resume, ONNX export path, fixed evaluation and run/device/throughput metrics. Verification: full Python suite 31 passed, 1 skipped because PyTorch is unavailable; TypeScript engine 8 passed; compileall clean. GPU optimizer updates, local PyTorch smoke, ONNX export, and Kaggle CUDA runtime remain unverified external validation gaps; no packages installed or remote job run.

goals.title: Browser Inference and Viewer
goals.objective: Build local web spectator that loads downloaded ONNX checkpoint offline, generates fresh seeded matches using the TypeScript engine, records/replays artifacts, scrubs matches and displays checkpoint/training metrics with requested luminous/cinematic visuals; verify browser/Python action parity.
goals.evidence: Implemented local browser spectator with offline ONNX Runtime Web/WASM inference, deterministic TypeScript match/replay, artifact manifest/schema/digest checks, playback/scrubbing and metrics UI. Verification: npm typecheck passed; viewer tests 4/4; Vite build passed; TS engine tests 8/8 including Python differential. No browser binary or real ONNX checkpoint available, so live browser inference/session parity remains unverified.

goals.title: Kaggle Lifecycle
goals.objective: Implement safe explicit Kaggle submit/status/download automation using current official CLI behavior, explicit target/revision/confirmation, bounded polling and staged atomic artifact validation; all tests mocked/dry-run, no credentials and no real remote run.
goals.evidence: Implemented local deterministic `arena kaggle prepare`, explicit confirmation-guarded submit, version-specific bounded status/download, schema/digest/hash validation and atomic staging promotion. Source bundle contains exact metadata/revision marker and self-contained trainer runner that preserves Kaggle's preinstalled CUDA PyTorch. Verification: Kaggle tests 8/8; package generation and dry-run preflight passed; compileall clean. No real Kaggle CLI, credentials, network submission or download used.

goals.title: Benchmark and Integration Verification
goals.objective: Integrate local UX/training/artifacts, document user workflow, measure rollout/PPO throughput on available hardware and choose by evidence (not GPU occupancy); run full tests/build/static checks and produce acceptance evidence for all MVP contracts.
goals.evidence: Final independent code review APPROVE with 0 findings; independent architecture review WATCH solely because PyTorch/ONNX/CUDA and browser WASM inference were unavailable. Local Python suite 57 passed, 1 torch smoke skipped; viewer 11 tests, TS engine 8, typecheck/build pass. This workspace has no torch, onnx runtime, nvidia-smi, ONNX checkpoint or browser binary. Kaggle credentials/remote submission deliberately unused per explicit user-invoked boundary.

reviewBlockerResolution.evidence: Kaggle v4 smoke/benchmark: cu128 CUDA on two visible T4s; measured best candidate 1,275.171 arena steps/s at 128×32, rollout 3.1946s vs optimizer 0.01793s. Kaggle v5 self-play: 300 PPO updates, 1,228,800 arena steps, 1,200 CUDA optimizer updates on one T4, 857.35s. Fixed paired held-out comparison: step-300 vs step-0 W/D/L 58/2/4 (90.6%, Wilson 81.0–95.6); vs open-space 1/4/59 (1.6%, Wilson 0.3–8.3), paired survival delta +13.125 ticks [11.234,15.000]. Step-300 remains weak against open-space; no DDP claim. Chromium verified actual ONNX WASM inference, match and full run bundle; evidence JSON/screenshot at artifacts/circuit-ai/reports/browser-acceptance/. Integrity review found raw sidecars omitted from manifest; both validators now reject all external-data sidecars, derived inline-weight viewer bundle validates. Final independent code review APPROVE, architect CLEAR; Python 76 passed+8 subtests, viewer 11 passed, typecheck/build pass.
